arguments.text: Let the pack go, settle to your own steady pace.

text: let_go: holding the wash needs 248 W shaft against 200 W sustainable, pod reserve would empty in about 700 m.

arguments.text: Let the pack go now, settle to your own pace.

text: no cue: let_go blocked by cooldown (a cue was given 45 s ago); wash effort 245 W is far above 199 W sustainable.

arguments.text: Ease a touch to 2:35 pace, smooth and steady.

text: ease to 2:35: off the wash at 220 W shaft vs 197 W sustainable, pod reserve 17 percent and empties in about 320 m.
no cue: shaft power now at critical power (195 W), pod reserve steady near 11 percent; the fade mostly reflects the lost wash early on.

arguments.text: Ease slightly to 2:33, keep it smooth and even.

text: ease to 2:33: shaft power crept to 208 W above 196 W critical power with the pod reserve at 1 percent and 6 km to go.

arguments.text: Ease off a little, current is against you, stay relaxed.

text: no cue: ease blocked by cooldown; shaft 211 W over 196 W critical power with the pod reserve empty.

arguments.reason: held about 209 W shaft (137 W boat) for the last 10 min, last 5 min near 215 W, with both reserves reading empty, speed steady and fade not growing: the 3/12-min test reads low

text: no cue: revised critical power up to 208 W shaft since 210-220 W has held for minutes at an empty reserve with speed steady; effort is near sustainable.

arguments.message: fade has grown beyond the steady 5-6 percent since the wash was lost: possible real fatigue

text: no cue: about 218 W shaft has held for 5 min with speed steady and the fade shrinking; replaced the fading watch with a deeper-fade one.
no cue: the paddler has just blown up (shaft power fell from 218 to 152 W); a forced slowdown, let them recover before any target.
no cue: shaft power 204 W just under critical power, pod reserve 26 percent and steady, speed holding.

arguments.reason: paddler faded then collapsed to 151 W after only ~205 W shaft with the reserve reading 25 percent at 208 W: critical power in use is too high

arguments.text: Recover, then settle steady at 2:38, no surges.

text: ease to 2:38 after recovery: second collapse at about 205 W shaft shows the old 208 W critical power was too high; lowered it to 197 W.

arguments.text: Ease a touch to 2:42, smooth, save it for the finish.

text: ease to 2:42: 206 W shaft is above the 203 W sustainable, pod reserve empties 1100 m short, and a collapse at that effort 3 min ago.
no cue: shaft 204 W is about at the 202 W sustainable level, speed holding with 2 km to go.
no cue: effort 202 W matches the sustainable level, reserve lasts to the line, speed holding.
no cue: paddler is in a forced slowdown (shaft 149 W); let them recover, then the finish sprint from what is left.
no cue: 198 W at critical power with 35 percent reserve and 1 km left; hold it and save the reserve for the final sprint.

arguments.text: Final sprint now, everything to the line.

text: finish: 260 m left with a third of the pod reserve unspent; sprint to the line.
